descriptionEn: This discussion will focus on climate investment and financing, energy transition, and cross-border development opportunities for enterprises, particularly targeting companies with mature technologies, equipment, or solutions that wish to expand into overseas markets and investment opportunities. The topics are especially suitable for heads of overseas business, business owners, and relevant decision-makers from companies planning to enter regions such as ASEAN, the Middle East, and North Africa. The discussion will revolve around how companies can align with local energy transition needs to design feasible, investable, and scalable projects and business models. description: 本场讨论将聚焦香港如何作为企业国际化发展的重要平台，支持内地企业借助香港走向海外市场。内容将重点探讨政府支持及资助、专业服务、跨境资源对接以及国际市场连接，如何帮助企业更高效地推进出海布局。对于希望拓展海外业务、建立国际合作网络、对接国际资本市场与专业服务资源的企业而言，这一议题具有很强的现实意义。讨论也将进一步关注绿色产业与可持续发展相关企业如何借助香港拓展更广阔的区域与国际机会。
descriptionEn: This discussion will focus on how Hong Kong serves as an important platform for the internationalization of enterprises, supporting mainland companies in accessing overseas markets through Hong Kong. The content will emphasize government support and funding, professional services, cross-border resource connections, and international market links, and how these can help companies more efficiently advance their overseas strategies. This topic is highly relevant for companies looking to expand their overseas business, establish international cooperation networks, and connect with international capital markets and professional service resources. The discussion will also further explore how green industries and sustainable development-related enterprises can leverage Hong Kong to expand into broader regional and international opportunities.
